title: A clearer front page
added: The front page now says plainly what the game is, shows real screenshots, and has the sign-up box at the top.
The sample hero cards on the front page now wear gear: some a couple of pieces, some their full kit, picked at random each visit.

title: Groundwork, continued
added: Nine painted scenes and a set of new drawings of Smudge, for something Smudge is still setting up.

title: A tune for every fight
added: Every boss now fights to its own music. Five new battle themes: ancient, gangster, northern, gothic and whatever Gary the Great White counts as

title: Groundwork
added: Every arrival now belongs to an era and a family. Something card-shaped is being built on top of it.

title: Room in the bag
added: The bag now shows how full it is: 90 different things to start with
Buy more room with gold, ten pockets at a time
fixed: A full bag means Smudge leaves new junk where it lies. Treasure, crates and tonics always come home, and a stack you already have can always grow

title: A proper account page
added: Your account is three tabs now, with your name, your picture and your four best numbers up top
Trades show a level bar each, and the counts are sorted and coloured
Battle music is picked at random on the Raids screen, and each boss will fight to its own era
fixed: Profile pictures are cut from each drawing's own face, so nobody is off-centre any more
No more scrolling to the bottom of your account to find anything
known: The new battle tracks are not in the build yet, so raids still use the old one
Alerts only reach you while the game is open

title: Raids pay properly
added: Every card marks what its hero is best and worst at
Resting heroes carry a countdown and the price to wake them
Beating a boss for the first time pays five times the gold
Deeper raids give more loot rolls, a crate, and shards
fixed: Waking a resting hero is now priced off the raid, not a flat rate
Boss gold raised across the board
Start over has moved out of your account; ask and it will be done for you
known: Alerts only reach you while the game is open

title: Raids, and your name in lights
added: The raid sheet rebuilt: the boss, what it is weak to, and what you win, all in one place
Every card in a picker now shows its stats, with green for what this boss hates
Titles and name colours, earned and worn under your name wherever other players see it
Smudge gives advice when a raid goes badly
fixed: The pick you made is obvious now: a gold ring and a number
The close button no longer hides behind the artwork
Scrollbars match the rest of the game
Your three are called by name during a fight
The FC mark is off the cards; Founding Clerk is a title now
known: Alerts only reach you while the game is open

title: Alerts, pictures and a tidy-up
added: A bell up top for friend requests and gifts
Pick your profile picture from any hero you have met
Update notes, which you are reading
Update emails, if you tick the box in your account
fixed: Friend requests no longer turn up unannounced
The account picture is bigger and no longer squashed
Changes made on another device now show up when you come back
Card frames, the ink shop and the raid patch-up have proper names
known: Alerts only reach you while the game is open
A few heroes still talk without moving their mouths

title: Loot and gold
added: Card frames, bought with gold
Buy ink with gold, a few pots a day
Pay gold to get resting heroes back on their feet
fixed: Era sets are three pieces everywhere
Gear for the newest heroes now drops
